about: A Tier-0 PIM activation (PIM-Tier0-Security-Admins / PIM-Tier0-CA-Admins) with no sign-in that satisfied authentication context c1 in the 30 minutes before the request. AuthenticationContextClassReferences is a STRING in both sign-in tables (Learn); its JSON shape [{id, detail}] follows the Graph signIn property (verify: in the tenant). ContextPolicies is committed empty, so only the 'no step-up' verdict can fire here.
